title: Which word fits the blank? | 집 Korean quiz
description:
MalmoeLab Korean fill-in-the-blank short for English learners.

Question: 저녁에는 ___에서 쉽니다.
Answer: 집 (jip)
Meaning: house
Example: 저녁에는 집에서 쉽니다.
English: I rest at home in the evening.
